item_short_desc: The Army Sharpshooter Weapons Qualification Badge is the second badge an individual can obtain after the Army Marksman Weapons Qualification Badge.
description: The Army Sharpshooter Weapons Qualification Badge is the second badge an individual can obtain after the Army Marksman Weapons Qualification Badge (Item# 1542). This military badge is obtained by hitting 30 to 35 out of 40 targets. The army badge that follows is Expert (Item# 1540).
